all_15_modes.name: _execute
steps: if false P09 original custody rejection
if true P46 original complete connection.execute call

all_15_modes.name: _call
steps: P06 original image lookup + request_packet + transition

all_15_modes.name: snapshot
steps: if row is None -> P21 call(2)
else SQL snapshot.sql2 with original row generation lookup; SQL snapshot.sql3 chained fetchone()[0]; P14 decode artifact; P21 call(2, tagged fields, flags=1,a=count)
read receipt.action; if zero construct original absent dict
else unpack four receipt fields; P12 first three; P14 artifact; construct original present dict

all_15_modes.name: validate_u64
steps: P11 _decimal(value) inside P20/P21 original argument point

all_15_modes.name: conditional
steps: P20 validate original generation then epoch
P04/P10 read snapshot fields then expected fields in original order
P32; if true P33 then P34 exact keyset; HIA short-circuit
P21 call(3,fields,flags=int(exact)) inside active exception continuation
AgentRejected match only: compare error.code; stale -> assign pending_slot_snapshot; bare rethrow

all_15_modes.name: _begin
steps: target is None selects one/two P11 fields and flags/labels

all_15_modes.name: admit_evaluation
steps: HIA loop over original three fixed names; P04 read one field then P13 wire then P21 call(17); no next-field read on error
if receipt.status in {16,17}: original truth chooses diagnostic set; P38 membership, then P09 if no TypeError

all_15_modes.name: adopt
steps: P04 active_artifact is not None -> P21 call12
if plan.action ==1: SQL adopt.sql1 then SQL adopt.sql2
else SQL adopt.sql3 chained fetchone -> P21 call4 -> P19 native -> P16 hash -> P21 call5
SQL adopt.sql4 returns cursor; preserve cursor local
P28 iter; HIA loop P29 next -> row bind -> P11 generation -> P21 call8, no count cap
P21 call9; P30 ASCII generation then epoch; construct current dict

all_15_modes.name: rollback
steps: P21 call10 flags row not None
P17 digest metadata then read current ABI -> P21 call11
P21 call9; decode two fields/construct current
branches: active and row facts passed to existing decision owner

all_15_modes.name: _lease_value
steps: P12 identity,slot,generation; P14 artifact in dict value order

all_15_modes.name: acquire
steps: P19 native(active) and discard original tuple result
P27 UUID then slot/gen encoding then P13 wire artifact
SQL acquire.sql1 with original field indexing/result.fields[3].decode
branches: none on host; existing HIA call6 decision

all_15_modes.name: lease
steps: P31 exact original keys validation first
connection is None chooses P02 or existing connection
row None selects four empty fields, else original id/slot/generation reads
row non-None then P36 type check; if true P37 second active read, else b'X'
only now read stored artifact -> P14 then P13
P15 claimed artifact and exact valid flag
release selects opcode14/13 -> P21 with all original arguments

primitive_kinds.name: get.store_db

primitive_kinds.name: dynamic.begin
